workflows.title: Krea 2 NSFW photo (LUSTIFY v10 + SNOFS)
workflows.summary: Krea 2's best NSFW finetune with the SNOFS concept LoRA on top: explicit, photoreal, 8 steps.
steps: Write what you want in the prompt box (natural language works best; SNOFS knows positions like cowgirl, doggystyle, missionary).
Pick an aspect ratio in the Resolution selector (2 MP for more detail).
Press Run. Lower the LoRA strength (0.5-0.7) if bodies look overcooked; turn the LoRA off for solo nudes.

workflows.title: DaSiWa MiniMax H3: NSFW image to video with sound
workflows.summary: Animate a photo into a 5 s clip with audio using DaSiWa's H3 Hybrid v4 Turbo (4 steps) and the HMNSFW LoRA.
steps: Load your start image (a clean, sharp photo; it becomes <Picture 1>).
Describe the motion and the sound in the prompt.
Set the duration (5 s = 124 frames; up to 15 s) and press Run. For a different look swap HMNSFW for another H3 LoRA at 0.6-1.0.

workflows.title: DaSiWa MiniMax H3: NSFW text to video with sound
workflows.summary: DaSiWa's H3 Hybrid with the HMNSFW LoRA, from text alone: adult clips with sound, 4 steps.
steps: Describe the people (adults), the action over time and the sound.
Pick the aspect ratio and the duration.
Press Run. The speed is baked in: keep 4 steps and don't add turbo LoRAs.

workflows.title: DaSiWa WAN 2.2: NSFW image to video
workflows.summary: DaSiWa's SnatchKiss v11 Lightspeed pair (4 steps, CFG 1) with the General NSFW LoRA pair at a light 0.4.
steps: Load your start image and match Width/Height to its aspect ratio (about 0.5-0.8 megapixels, e.g. 576x1024).
Describe the motion in the prompt; at CFG 1 the negative prompt is ignored.
Press Run (81 frames = 5 s at 16 fps). Don't add speed LoRAs: the speed is baked in. Swap the LoRA pair for another Wan concept pair (0.3-0.6).

workflows.title: LTX-2.3: NSFW image to video with sound (DR34ML4Y)
workflows.summary: LTX-2.3 with the DR34ML4Y all-in-one sex LoRA: adult clips with sound from one picture; a position keyword picks the act.
steps: Load the start image (adults only).
Start the prompt with a position keyword (m15510n4ry, c0wg1rl, d0gg1e, bl0wj0b...), then describe the action and sound.
Press Run (8 + 3 steps).

workflows.title: MOSS-Image: uncensored photo and anime
workflows.summary: The new Apache-2.0 model that does NSFW without LoRAs; prompt enhancer off and 'nsfw' removed from the negative.
steps: Write the prompt (photo or anime both work; natural language).
Keep the prompt enhancer off for adult prompts (it rewrites them).
Press Run (25 steps). Add the MOSS turbo LoRA for 4 steps.

workflows.title: Z-Image NSFW photo (PornMaster Turbo)
workflows.summary: Z-Image Turbo's leading NSFW finetune: fast (8 steps) photoreal adult images on 12 GB.
steps: Write the prompt in the Positive Prompt box.
Press Run. Add one Z-Image NSFW LoRA with a LoRA loader for specific acts.

workflows.title: Krea 2 Turbo text to image
workflows.summary: The official Krea 2 Turbo workflow: 8 steps, optional prompt enhancer and style LoRA switch.
steps: Write a detailed prompt (the enhancer can expand short ones).
Pick the aspect ratio and press Run.
Flip 'Enable LoRA' for Krea's ink-wash style, or load any Krea 2 LoRA there.

workflows.title: Krea 2 style change from a reference image
workflows.summary: Generate a new picture in the style of 1-3 reference images (ostris' style-reference LoRA on Krea 2 Turbo).
steps: Load the style reference image (paintings, photos, renders; 1-3 images).
Describe the new subject in the prompt; the style comes from the image.
Press Run.

workflows.title: Krea 2 painting and drawing styles
workflows.summary: Krea 2 Turbo with a painting LoRA on (impressionism). Swap in any Krea 2 look: watercolor, colored pencil, comic ink, 90s anime, claymation, C64 pixel art, tarot, propaganda poster.
steps: Describe the subject; the style's trigger words go in the LoRA trigger box.
Press Run (8 steps).
For another look pick a different Krea 2 LoRA (Suggested > Stylize) and type its trigger words.

workflows.title: MOSS-Image art styles (comic, sketch, paint, pixel)
workflows.summary: MOSS-Image with a style LoRA chained in (70s European comics). Swap it for pencil sketch, dark ink lines, fantasy paint, pixel art or 80s horror.
steps: Describe the scene.
Press Run (25 steps).
Swap the style LoRA on the main node for another MOSS style (Suggested > Stylize).

workflows.title: Z-Image Turbo art styles (ink wash, comic, anime, 3D)
workflows.summary: Z-Image Turbo with a Chinese ink-wash LoRA chained in; swap it for comic book, cyberpunk anime, 90s anime, Octane 3D or Daubrez painterly.
steps: Describe the scene; keep the trigger words at the start.
Press Run (8 steps).
Swap the style LoRA on the main node for another Z-Image style.

workflows.title: Qwen-Image 2.1 edit: outfit, pose, background, style
workflows.summary: Edit a photo with words, or combine up to 10 reference images: change clothes, copy a pose from another picture, swap the background, relight.
steps: Load the image to edit (it sets the canvas); add more images for references (<image2>, <image3>...).
Describe the change, e.g. 'Make the woman in <image1> take the pose of the person in <image2>'.
Press Run (8 steps). For explicit edits add a Qwen 2.1 NSFW LoRA.

workflows.title: MOSS-Image edit by instruction
workflows.summary: Say what to change and MOSS-Image redraws only that: colour, material, outfit or background; face, pose and framing stay.
steps: Load the photo.
Write one instruction: what changes, and what must stay.
Press Run (30 steps).

workflows.title: New camera angles of a character or scene (Qwen Edit 2511)
workflows.summary: Re-shoot one picture from another angle: orbit around, look from above or below, step closer, with a 3D camera control.
steps: Load the picture.
Set the angle in the 3D camera node (drag it, or type azimuth, elevation, distance).
Press Run (4 steps); change the angle and run again for a turnaround.

workflows.title: Z-Image ControlNet: pose, depth or edges
workflows.summary: Copy the composition of a reference picture (Canny edges by default; feed a depth map or a pose skeleton instead) onto a new Z-Image Turbo image.
steps: Load the control image.
Write the prompt for the new picture and press Run.
For pose: replace the Canny node with SDPose's skeleton (install the SDPose pack) and keep strength around 0.8.

workflows.title: MOSS-Image layout: place things with boxes
workflows.summary: Draw boxes, give each one a caption (or text to print), and MOSS-Image puts every element where you placed it.
steps: Write the overall prompt.
In Create Bounding Boxes, draw a box per element and caption it (text boxes get rendered).
Press Run (25 steps).

workflows.title: Z-Image Turbo text to image
workflows.summary: The official Z-Image Turbo workflow: photoreal in 8 steps.
steps: Write the prompt and press Run.

workflows.title: Anima anime text to image
workflows.summary: The official Anima Base workflow with its turbo switch: Danbooru tags or natural language, NSFW-capable.
steps: Write tags or a sentence (score and quality tags go in the negative).
Flip the turbo switch for 8 steps at CFG 1.
Press Run.

workflows.title: Anima anime inpainting
workflows.summary: Paint over part of an anime picture and Anima redraws just that part (face, hands, outfit, background), blended in.
steps: Load the picture.
Paint the area to redraw in the Painter (white = redraw).
Describe what goes there and press Run (turbo: 8 steps).

workflows.title: Anima line art / sketch to finished anime art
workflows.summary: Load a sketch, line art or any picture: Anima follows its lines (canny edges) and paints a finished anime illustration.
steps: Load the sketch, line art or reference picture.
Describe the character, colours and style.
Press Run; lower the control strength for more freedom.

workflows.title: Anima artist styles (@artist tags or an artist LoRA)
workflows.summary: Anima Base with an artist LoRA chained in (Arthur Rackham's pen, ink and watercolor). Or turn it off and write any of the thousands of artists Anima knows as @name.
steps: Finish the prompt with your subject (the artist's template is already there).
Press Run (30 steps; turbo for 8).
For another artist, bypass the LoRA and write @name (Suggested > This artist), or load another Anima artist LoRA.

workflows.title: MiniMax H3 image to video with sound
workflows.summary: The official MiniMax H3 workflow: a 5 s clip with stereo audio from one picture (or none, for text to video).
steps: Load the start image.
Describe the motion and the audio.
Enable the Lightning LoRA for 8 steps, then press Run.

workflows.title: MiniMax H3 text to video with sound
workflows.summary: The official MiniMax H3 text-to-video workflow: one prompt, a 5 s clip with voice, effects and music in one pass.
steps: Describe the shot, the action over time and the sound (dialogue in quotes).
Pick the aspect ratio and the duration (up to 15 s).
Press Run. Turbo mode (8 steps) is on; turn it off for the 20-step full-quality pass.

workflows.title: MiniMax H3 video in a comic style (Ink Riot)
workflows.summary: Text to video with sound in a graphic comic look (bold ink outlines, hard cel shadows). Swap in the 80s cel anime or 80s fantasy-movie LoRA.
steps: Keep the trigger words first, then describe the shot, the action and the sound.
Press Run (turbo, 8 steps).
Swap the style LoRA on the main node for Safari Eyes (80s cel anime) or 1980s Fantasy Movies.

workflows.title: MiniMax H3 first & last frame to video (Pika H3 Flex)
workflows.summary: Give a start picture and an end picture; H3 with Pika's Flex adapter animates the way between them, with sound.
steps: Load the first frame and the last frame (same aspect ratio).
Describe how the shot gets from the first picture to the last, plus the sound.
Press Run (6 steps).

workflows.title: LTX-2.3 image to video with sound
workflows.summary: Lightricks' LTX-2.3 (22B): a 5 s clip with synced sound from one picture, two-stage with a x2 latent upscale.
steps: Load the start image.
Describe the action over time, the visual details and the sound.
Set width, height and duration, then press Run.

workflows.title: LTX-2.3 lip sync: talking or singing from a picture + audio
workflows.summary: Animate a face to a voice or song: LTX-2.3 image + audio to video, with lips, head and hands moving to the sound.
steps: Load the picture and the audio (speech or a song, up to about 20 s).
Describe the person and how they move while they talk or sing.
Set the audio start and duration, then press Run.

workflows.title: MiniMax H3 pose transfer from a video
workflows.summary: Copy the moves of a driving video onto your character with H3's Fun ControlNet and SDPose skeletons, with sound.
steps: Load the driving video (the moves) and describe the character and scene.
Check the pose preview, then press Run.

workflows.title: Wan Animate 2: character swap / motion transfer
workflows.summary: Make the person in your reference image perform the moves of a driving video (distilled Wan Animate 2, 10 steps).
steps: Load the reference image (the character) and the driving video (the moves).
Describe the character and the action, then press Run.

workflows.title: SeedVR2 image upscale
workflows.summary: Upscale and restore a photo or illustration with SeedVR2 7B (one step, sharp real detail).
steps: Load the image.
Set the target size in the resize node (2x is a good start) and press Run.

workflows.title: SeedVR2 video upscale
workflows.summary: Upscale a finished clip 2x with SeedVR2 3B, in chunks so long videos fit.
steps: Load the video.
Press Run (split the latent for long clips on small GPUs).

workflows.title: Frame interpolation (smoother video)
workflows.summary: Double or triple a clip's frame rate with FILM (or RIFE 4.26): 16 fps Wan to 32 fps, 24 fps H3 to 48 fps.
steps: Load the video.
Set the multiplier (2 is typical) and press Run.

workflows.title: Illustrious NSFW anime with hires fix and face detailer
workflows.summary: WAI-illustrious v17 with an artist-style LoRA slot, a 1.5x hires pass through 2x-AnimeSharpV4 and Impact's FaceDetailer for crisp faces.
steps: Write Danbooru tags in the positive prompt (quality tags are already there); add an artist tag or turn on the LoRA slot with any 'This artist' LoRA.
Press Run: base image, 1.5x hires pass, then the face detailer.
For explicit detail add the NSFW detector kit to a second detailer pass.

workflows.title: Illustrious pose swap (SDPose + NoobAI OpenPose)
workflows.summary: Copy the pose of any photo or drawing: SDPose turns it into a skeleton and the NoobAI OpenPose ControlNet makes WAI-illustrious draw your character in that pose.
steps: Load the pose reference image (a person in the pose you want).
Check the skeleton preview; describe your character in the prompt.
Press Run. Lower ControlNet strength (0.6-0.8) to let the model adjust anatomy.

workflows.title: Illustrious artist styles (artist LoRA + style slot + artist tags)
workflows.summary: WAI-illustrious with an artist LoRA on (Masami Obari's 90s OVA look), a second slot ready for a style (sumi-e ink), a hires pass and the face detailer. Add native artist tags to mix your own look.
steps: Write Danbooru tags; the artist's trigger words are already in.
Press Run: base image, 1.5x hires pass, face detailer.
Swap the artist LoRA for any 'This artist' LoRA, turn on the style slot (Ctrl+B), or add artist tags like (wlop:0.8).

workflows.title: Fast 4x upscale (UltraSharpV2)
workflows.summary: Pixel upscale any image 4x in seconds with UltraSharp V2 (swap in 2x-AnimeSharpV4 for anime).
steps: Load the image.
Press Run. For anime, pick 2x-AnimeSharpV4 in the loader.

workflows.title: Remove the background (BiRefNet)
workflows.summary: Cut the subject out of any picture: a transparent-background image and its mask, hair included.
steps: Load the picture.
Press Run.
Right-click the result and save it (PNG keeps the transparency).

workflows.title: Image to prompt (Qwen3-VL)
workflows.summary: Describe a picture as a ready-to-use prompt (subject, clothes, pose, setting, light, camera, style), e.g. for image to video.
steps: Load the picture.
Change the instruction if you want a different kind of description.
Press Run and copy the text.

workflows.title: Image to 3D model (Pixal3D / TRELLIS.2)
workflows.summary: One picture to a textured 3D model with PBR materials, saved as GLB; background removed automatically.
steps: Load a picture of one object or character (plain background is best).
Pick Pixal3D or TRELLIS.2 with the switch.
Press Run; the GLB is in output/3d and shows in the 3D preview.

workflows.title: Text to music with vocals (MiniMax Music 3)
workflows.summary: Complete songs with vocals from a caption (genre, BPM, key, mood, instruments) and your lyrics, up to 5 minutes.
steps: Write the caption: genre, tempo, key, mood, instruments, voice.
Write the lyrics with [Verse] / [Chorus] sections.
Set max_duration and press Run; the MP3 is in output/audio.
